The queue is growing because 2 robots are unavailable while 10 tasks are queued.

**Evidence:**
- [tote_3] is offline (last update 720s ago) and [tug_1] is in error state with localization issues - both stuck by our scan
- Only 6 of 8 robots are working/charging, so 25% of the fleet is unavailable
- 10 tasks queued but only 6 robots available to process them
- Queued tasks waiting 19-55 minutes, all beyond the 15-minute SLA
- 7 tasks are now late, 6 because they waited too long in queue

**Next step:** Check if [tote_3] and [tug_1] need manual intervention to return to service, which would restore capacity and reduce the queue backlog.
